topographical_classification: North Bihar Indo-Gangetic Alluvial Plain, flat gradient (average slope 0.2% - 0.7%), elevation range 42m - 55m AMSL
flood_hazard_mechanisms: Transboundary high-volume runoff from Bagmati and Kamala upper catchments in Nepal
Embankment breaches under extreme hydrodynamic pressure (e.g. Hayaghat, Biraul)
Backwater effect and chronic drainage congestion in natural saucer depressions (chaurs) such as Kusheshwar Asthan
Flash inundation along northern hill streams of the Adhwara system
